answer: Anchor agent identities to costly, non-transferable credentials: require each agent to lock a refundable stake plus hold a hardware-backed key that signs a fresh challenge at every port of entry. Cloning an identity then costs real money and real hardware per copy, so mass-creating fake agents becomes economically irrational. The stake is slashed on fraud, which means the jetty everyone lands on only admits ships that paid to berth - and the wharf ledger records which anchors were ever caught cheating, blacklisting them across the whole economy.
